-- Read-only subset of model-provider-health.ts:40-104 for the two admitted own subscriptions.
-- Returns at most the selected permanent/transient observations; never provider messages.
WITH requested AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t."userId" AS actor,b."ownerId" AS owner,
    r."agentDefinition"#>>'{executionIdentity,workspaceId}' AS workspace,
    c.id::text AS id,c.epoch,r."agentDefinition"->>'harness' AS harness,
    r."agentDefinition"->>'model' AS model
  FROM factory_tasks t JOIN factory_attempts a ON a."taskId"=t.id
  JOIN agent_runs r ON r.id=a."runId" AND r."userId"=t."userId" AND r."issueId"=t."issueId"
  JOIN byos_bindings b ON b.id::text=r."agentDefinition"#>>'{subscription,bindingId}'
  JOIN byos_connections c ON c.id=b."connectionId" AND c."ownerId"=b."ownerId"
  WHERE t.id='e42571e5-58f7-40e3-9418-c02ee8843fe6'::uuid
    AND a.id IN ('41e41625-f1e2-4b2d-9d62-9fecbc4d62ae'::uuid,
                 'aa77cb0b-bb48-4c7a-ab73-ad68e7df7dba'::uuid)
    AND b."ownerId"=t."userId" AND c.state='connected' AND NOT c.paused
), sources AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT actor,owner,workspace,id,epoch FROM requested
), observations AS (
  SELECT s.id,r.id AS "runId",r.status,
    CASE WHEN r."stopReason"='provider_failure' AND r."stopRequestedAt" IS NULL
      THEN r.report->'providerFailure' END AS failure,
    r."agentDefinition"->>'harness' AS harness,
    r."agentDefinition"->'subscription'->>'modelId' AS model,
    COALESCE(r."startedAt",r."createdAt") AS "beganAt",
    COALESCE(r."finishedAt",r."updatedAt") AS "providerObservedAt"
  FROM sources s JOIN agent_runs r ON r."userId"=s.actor
  WHERE COALESCE(r."agentDefinition"->'executionIdentity'->>'workspaceId',
      (SELECT bot."workspaceId"::text FROM bots bot WHERE bot.id=r."botId" AND bot."ownerId"=r."userId"))=s.workspace
    AND (r.status='succeeded' OR (r."stopReason"='provider_failure' AND r."stopRequestedAt" IS NULL
      AND r.report->'providerFailure'->>'kind' IN ('balance','auth','unavailable')
      AND jsonb_typeof(r.report->'providerFailure'->'retryable')='boolean'))
    AND EXISTS(
      SELECT 1 FROM byos_bindings b
      WHERE b.id::text=r."agentDefinition"->'subscription'->>'bindingId'
        AND b."connectionId"::text=s.id AND b."ownerId"=s.owner
        AND b."workspaceId"=s.workspace AND b."connectionRevision"=s.epoch
    )
), history AS (
  SELECT *,max("beganAt") FILTER (WHERE status='succeeded' AND failure IS NULL) OVER (PARTITION BY id) AS "lastSourceSuccess",
    max("beganAt") FILTER (WHERE status='succeeded' AND failure IS NULL) OVER (PARTITION BY id,harness,model) AS "lastEntrySuccess"
  FROM observations
), permanent AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) 'permanent'::text AS class,id,"runId",NULL::text AS harness,NULL::text AS model,
    failure,"beganAt","providerObservedAt"
  FROM history
  WHERE failure->>'kind' IN ('balance','auth') AND ("lastSourceSuccess" IS NULL OR "beganAt">"lastSourceSuccess")
  ORDER BY id,"beganAt" DESC,"providerObservedAt" DESC,"runId" DESC
), transient AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (h.id,h.harness,h.model) 'transient'::text AS class,h.id,h."runId",h.harness,h.model,
    h.failure,h."beganAt",h."providerObservedAt"
  FROM history h JOIN requested req ON req.id=h.id AND req.harness=h.harness AND req.model=h.model
  WHERE h.failure->>'kind'='unavailable' AND (h."lastEntrySuccess" IS NULL OR h."beganAt">h."lastEntrySuccess")
  ORDER BY h.id,h.harness,h.model,h."beganAt" DESC,h."providerObservedAt" DESC,h."runId" DESC
), selected AS (SELECT * FROM permanent UNION ALL SELECT * FROM transient)
SELECT clock_timestamp() AS "observedAt",class,id AS "connectionId","runId",harness,model,
  failure->>'kind' AS "failureKind",failure->'retryable' AS retryable,
  (failure->>'kind' IN ('balance','auth') AND failure->'retryable'='false'::jsonb
    OR failure->>'kind'='unavailable' AND failure->'retryable'='true'::jsonb) AS "retryableMatchesKind",
  NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(failure) key WHERE key NOT IN ('kind','retryable','status','code')) AS "failureKeysClosed",
  CASE WHEN NOT (failure ? 'status') THEN true
    WHEN jsonb_typeof(failure->'status')='number' THEN (failure->>'status')::numeric BETWEEN 100 AND 599
      AND (failure->>'status')::numeric=trunc((failure->>'status')::numeric)
    ELSE false END AS "statusValid",
  CASE WHEN NOT (failure ? 'code') THEN true
    WHEN failure->>'kind'='balance' THEN failure->>'code' IN ('payment_required','insufficient_balance','insufficient_quota','billing_hard_limit','billing_error')
    WHEN failure->>'kind'='auth' THEN failure->>'code' IN ('authentication_failed','invalid_api_key')
    ELSE failure->>'code' IN ('rate_limit','overloaded','server_error','timeout','connection_error') END AS "codeValid",
  "beganAt","providerObservedAt",
  ("providerObservedAt"+interval '120 seconds') AS "transientRetryAt",
  (class='permanent' OR clock_timestamp()<"providerObservedAt"+interval '120 seconds') AS "timeWindowWouldBlock"
FROM selected ORDER BY class,id,harness,model;
